customConcept.blurb: A Michelin star in a Danube cathedral town: two tasting menus and an owner the internet watches eat.

state.circumstances: November 2022, Széchenyi tér, Esztergom. The first Michelin Guide Hungary has just given 42 a star, in a cathedral town an hour up the Danube from Budapest. Chef Ádám Barna cooks two tasting menus, one of them built on Hungarian heritage. The owner is a man half a million people watch eat at the world's best restaurants on YouTube, and now his own is under the same eyes. Food prices in Hungary are rising faster than anywhere in the EU.

ev.text: The owner's latest video mentioned 42 and the booking page crashed.
Food prices in Hungary jumped again: butter, flour and pork up by double digits.
A commenter accused the owner of reviewing his own competition. The comments filled with it.
Advent: company dinners and visitors from Budapest filled the room.

world.notes: 42 is a real fine-dining restaurant on Széchenyi tér in Esztergom, Hungary, owned by Sándor Varga, who reviews restaurants and hotels on YouTube as Alexander the Guest. Its chef, Ádám Barna, came from St Andrea in Budapest. On 3 November 2022 the first Michelin Guide Hungary gave it one star. In 2022 it offered two tasting menus, one of international flavours and one of Hungarian heritage ('Heritage and Inspiration'); the nine-course menu cost HUF 39,000 (about EUR 96). It opens for dinner from Wednesday to Saturday. Hungary's food inflation was among the highest in the EU in late 2022. The player runs the restaurant for the owner; the owner and chef are written from their public record. The seat count, staff other than Barna, rent and events are estimated or invented.

United States.mealTimes: Lunch around noon to 1pm, dinner from about 6 to 8pm.
United States.customs: Guests expect fast, attentive service, free tap water and refills, and a check brought on request. Tipping 18-22% is expected at table service.
United States.labour: At-will employment in most states; overtime after 40 hours a week; minimum wages set by state and city.

Hungary.name: Hungary

alcohol.note: Licensed with the business; Hungarian wine is a point of pride.

Hungary.mealTimes: Lunch from noon; dinner from 6 or 7pm.
Hungary.customs: A service charge of 10-15% is often added; otherwise a 10% tip. Fine-dining guests expect Hungarian wines and ingredients explained.
Hungary.labour: Employers pay a social contribution tax on wages; minimum wage and guaranteed wage minimum for skilled work rise every year.
